title: Dependency-Ready AIAS Enterprise Offices
purpose: Institutionalize accountable enterprise offices as executable charters without claiming offices whose dependencies are unavailable.
scope: Ten dependency-ready office charters, atomic registry, unique accountability routing, decision authorization, evidence gates, KPIs, escalation and explicit AI Office deferral.

requirements.title: Complete charters
requirements.statement: Each active office shall declare mandate, accountability, decision rights, evidence, KPIs and escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Dependency honesty
requirements.statement: Offices with unavailable dependencies shall remain explicitly deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Unique accountability
requirements.statement: Work items shall route to exactly one accountable office.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Decision control
requirements.statement: The registry shall allow only charter-authorized roles with complete evidence to decide an assigned work item.
requirements.rationale: Preserve separation of duties and auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumers
requirements.statement: Security recovery and capability automation work shall route through their real accountable offices.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Office foundation shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
